statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry)
The diagnosis codes are G45.9 and I49.5 (transient cerebral ischemic attack, not specified; and sick sinus syndrome)
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and transient visual disturbances concerning for transient cerebral ischemic attacks in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
The denial reason is PR-204 (service not covered under member's current benefit plan)
